description:
crate-jmap-server/src/response.rs:85 defines:

```rust
pub struct RequestError { ... }
```

It does not implement std::error::Error or Display, despite the name. Callers can construct it but can't `?` it or print it via `{}`.

Per AGENTS.md crate-jmap-server is LOCKED — needs Mark's approval before edit.

Options:
1. Implement std::error::Error + Display (probably the right fix)
2. Rename the struct to indicate it's a wire payload, not a Rust error (e.g. RequestErrorPayload)

Note: this struct is used to construct HTTP problem-details responses (RFC 7807), so calling it 'Error' is reasonable from the wire-spec perspective but confuses Rust idiom expectations.
title: P2: RequestError struct named 'Error' but doesn't impl std::error::Error or Display
